name: BlakeStone-Vita
description: Port of Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold and Blake Stone: Planet Strike for PSVITA/PSTV.
long_description:
Port of Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold and Blake Stone: Planet Strike for PSVITA/PSTV.
This build has a corrected LZH save system and minor fixes, and allows on-screen keyboard input for save games and high scores.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
